text: Chemical engineering and technology originated during the Industrial Revolution in the 19th century and gradually formed a complete system along with the development of the chemical industry. This discipline centers on "process scale-up" and "system optimization", studying how to transform chemical reactions and separation processes in the laboratory into large-scale industrial production, while addressing issues such as efficiency, energy consumption, cost and environmental protection in production. Its development level directly affects the competitiveness of the country's pillar industries such as chemical engineering, energy and materials, and is an important force in promoting industrial modernization.
